min_trace_source-s: CONFLICT ON MULTI-CB'S OWN PAGES. Design parameters, H/I Conductors, Special production (min.): width 75 um / space 75 um ('exemplary for 35um copper thickness'); pooling page, Non-Pool Special production: 'Min. track / space, annular ring >= 75um'. Technical options, Special production: 'Conductor width / spacing min. 75um/105um 90um/90um'. BGA design page, 0.50 mm pitch: 'Track-width / -space 70um/90um', inner-layer fan-out with 1 track 80/80 um. Top level takes the design-parameters 75/75; at 75/105 or 90/90 one track needs 0.285 / 0.27 mm. Confirm on the quote. https://www.multi-circuit-boards.eu/en/pcb-design-aid/design-parameters.html ; https://www.multi-circuit-boards.eu/en/products/printed-circuit-boards.html ; https://www.multi-circuit-boards.eu/en/pcb-design-aid/bga-pcb-design-for-ball-grid-array.html

note: Multi-CB's special production as its own profile, so tools that read only the top-level floors see it; the online / pool profile is multi_cb.json. Read 2026-10-23 with curl, no LLM. For a 0.50 mm BGA with 0.24 mm pads (0.26 mm channel): 75/75 fits one track (0.225 mm), 75/105 or 90/90 do not; Multi-CB's own 0.5 mm proposal is 70/90 (0.25 mm). Via-in-pad at 0.5 mm pitch is the 100/300 um via whose filling the via-in-pad page lists as 'none' and the BGA page as Type VII -- ask on the quote.

stackups_note: Only the free 8-layer defined buildup 8L-01 (1.7 mm) is published (from multi_cb.json, read 2026-10-17); Multi-CB publishes no 10-layer buildup -- special production uses a 'custom' buildup set on the quote (pooling page, 8 layers: 'Layer buildup | defined: 8L-01 (1.7mm), variable | | custom'). Four 'Defined layer buildups' (free of charge, also in pool). Every layer thickness and every Ԑr is printed in the PDF and the same figures appear in the four PNG images on the impedance-examples page; images were viewed to place each Ԑr on its layer (PDF text extraction scrambles the column order). Header note: 'Only nominal values'; 'Specified prepreg thicknesses: after pressing, at approx. 80% copper utilisation on the inner layers.' Outer copper is printed 'Cu 18µm + plating' with 35µm in the thickness column, so thickness_mm 0.035 is the plated value and weight_oz/copper_outer_oz 0.5 is the 18 µm base foil. No 2-layer stackup with Ԑr is published, and no 1.6 mm 8-layer (8L-01 is 1.7 mm). Order: 4L-01 (1.6), 6L-01 (1.6), 8L-01 (1.7), then 4L-02 (1.0). The default 'variable layer buildup' (FR4 1,55 mm, prepregs/cores vary with availability) has no published stackup. Separate Rogers 4350B/FR4 hybrid buildup PDF exists but was not transcribed (RF material).
